source_note: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程
english_source_note: Functional Equations via the Identity Theorem
callout_id: 利用连续函数的identity theorem证明函数方程#2
statement_en: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$ be a continuous function such that for every positive integer $n$ and every real number $x$, $$f(x)=f\left(x+\frac{1}{n}\right).$$ Prove that $f(x)$ is a constant function.
key_techniques: continuity plus density of rational numbers
callout_body: 函数$f:\mathbb{R}\to \mathbb{R}$是一个连续函数，并且满足对任意的正整数$n$,以及任意的实数$x$都有$$f(x)=f(x+\frac{1}{n})$$证明函数$f(x)$是一个常函数。
